call_points.text: Management will hold FY27 guidance until more clarity on margin recovery is available in Q2.
Heltar acquisition is a capability buy, not a large-scale business acquisition, funded by internal accruals.
New product portfolio (RCS, WhatsApp) is growing at 14% YoY, significantly ahead of the company average.
The Colombian security incident investigation is ongoing; management expects minimal additional costs beyond the Q1 provision.

industry: Telecommunication > Telecom - Services > Other Telecom Services

operating_notes.text: Net revenue retention stands at 98% for the year, with slight impact from one key customer.
Cash conversion for Q1 was weak due to delayed collections from large clients in India and UAE, but expected to revert to 75-100% for the full year.

timeline.summary: Route Mobile reported Q1FY27 results with 10% YoY revenue growth, announced the acquisition of Heltar Technologies, and discussed margin pressures and strategic initiatives on its earnings call.

watchlist.response: Management did not provide a specific answer during the call, stating they would revert later.
watchlist.text: Sales and marketing headcount declined double-digit sequentially and YoY, with no clear explanation provided.

watchlist.response: The investigation is ongoing; management expects minimal additional costs beyond the Q1 provision and is hopeful of recovering the affected business soon.
watchlist.text: Impact of the Colombian security incident on margins and customer relationships is not fully quantified.
